title: Everyone's Getting BETTER At Today 🎂
description:
In this town, when your day goes wrong, you get it again, and only you remember.

Today is my birthday. Nobody has said so, and today has now happened five times. Every time, everyone does it a little better.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment AGAIN if you'd have caught on by the second today.
